title: platform/consent.json
description: This dealer's cookie consent settings, baked by the platform on every publish. Platform-owned and regenerated wholesale. Absent, or mode "off", means no banner and no gating: the build is identical to one made before consent existed. A present file with an unknown mode is read as opt-in (fail closed).

mode.description: opt-in (GDPR): non-essential categories are off until the visitor allows them. opt-out (CCPA): they are on until the visitor rejects them. Global Privacy Control opts a visitor with no stored choice out in both modes; a choice they make afterwards is honoured.

version.description: Raise it to ask every visitor again, e.g. after the policy changes. A stored choice from another version is ignored.

expiryDays.description: How long a choice is remembered, 1 to 3650 days. Defaults to 365.

categories.description: Non-essential categories offered to the visitor. Defaults to analytics and marketing. Every category an enabled analytics provider declares is added automatically, so no provider can become impossible to allow.

policyUrl.description: The cookie policy page: a site path (/cookie-policy) or an http(s) URL. Anything else is dropped.

revisitButton.description: Show the floating "Cookie settings" button after a choice. Defaults to true. A link to #cookie-settings anywhere on the page opens the preferences either way.

text.description: Banner copy. Any key left out uses the default English text.

categoryText.description: Label and description per category, keyed by category name (essential included).

layout.description: box: a floating card. banner: a full-width bar. Defaults to box.

position.description: Where the banner sits. bottom and top are full-width bars whatever the layout. Defaults to bottom-left.

theme.description: Preset text and background colours. Defaults to light.

primaryColor.description: Buttons, links and switches. Absent follows the site's accent token.

buttonTextColor.description: Text on the primary button and the revisit button. Defaults to white.

fontFamily.description: A CSS font stack, or inherit. Absent uses the site's body font.

fontSize.description: Base text size in px. Defaults to 14.

showReject.description: Offer Reject All on the banner and in the preferences. Defaults to true.

showPreferences.description: Offer Customize on the banner. Defaults to true.

reloadOnChoice.description: Reload the page after every choice. Defaults to false; a withdrawal always reloads.

revisitPosition.description: Where the floating revisit button sits. Defaults to bottom-left.

defaultOn.description: Categories whose switch starts on in the preferences before a visitor has chosen. Starting on is not consent: nothing runs until they save.

gcmEnabled.description: Send Google Consent Mode v2 signals: default from the stored choice, update on every choice. Defaults to false.

gcmAdsDataRedaction.description: With Consent Mode, redact ads data while ad storage is denied. Defaults to true.

gcmUrlPassthrough.description: With Consent Mode, pass click identifiers through URLs. Defaults to true.

gpcEnabled.description: Honour the Global Privacy Control signal as an opt-out. Defaults to true.

gpcShowConfirmation.description: Confirm visibly when a Global Privacy Control opt-out is honoured. Defaults to true.

dnsEnabled.description: Enable the Do Not Sell or Share opt-out: a link to #do-not-sell, or data-bz-do-not-sell. Defaults to true.

autoclear.description: Delete cookies of categories that are not allowed (HttpOnly cookies cannot be). Defaults to true.

logging.description: Record each choice as proof of consent, without an IP address. Defaults to true.

cookies.description: The cookie register: shown to visitors, and — for a non-essential cookie with a pattern — the script setting it is blocked until its category is allowed. Absent uses the default register.

pattern.description: Pipe-separated pieces of script or iframe URLs, matched anywhere in the URL.

necessaryCategories.description: Categories that are always active, like Essential: locked on for the visitor, never blocked, never auto-cleared. Each must also be offered.
